story.fullStory:
Pavement's "Gold Soundz" — original release 1999. "Gold Soundz" is the second single released from Pavement's 1994 album Crooked Rain, Crooked Rain.

Artist: Pavement · Title: Gold Soundz · Album: Gold Soundz · Year: 1994 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/Pavement - Gold Soundz.mp4.

The song did not perform particularly well as a single, failing to chart on the Billboard Hot Modern Rock Tracks chart, where their previous single, "Cut Your Hair", peaked at number 10.

All the B-sides from both versions of the single are included on the reissue Crooked Rain, Crooked Rain: LA's Desert Origins.

facts.text: Gold Soundz is performed by Pavement.
Artist: Pavement · Title: Gold Soundz · Album: Gold Soundz · Year: 1994 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/Pavement - Gold Soundz.mp4
"Gold Soundz" is the second single released from Pavement's 1994 album Crooked Rain, Crooked Rain.
The song did not perform particularly well as a single, failing to chart on the Billboard Hot Modern Rock Tracks chart, where their previous single, "Cut Your Hair", peaked at number 10.
All the B-sides from both versions of the single are included on the reissue Crooked Rain, Crooked Rain: LA's Desert Origins.

The discography of Pavement, a Stockton, California-based indie rock group, consists of five studio albums, five double-length reissues of the albums, one compilation, ten extended plays, and thirteen singles.

This list does not include material performed by members or former members of Pavement that was recorded with Stephen Malkmus and the Jicks, Silver Jews, Preston School of Industry, Free Kitten, The Crust Brothers, or any other associated solo or side projects.
Pavement was formed in 1989 by Stephen Malkmus (guitars, vocals) and Scott Kannberg (guitars), although Malkmus stated that at this stage they "weren't a real band".
Pavement is an American indie rock band that formed in Stockton, California in 1989.

For most of their career, the group consisted of vocalist and guitarist Stephen Malkmus, guitarist and vocalist Scott Kannberg, bassist Mark Ibold, drummer Steve West and vocalist and multi-instrumentalist Bob Nastanovich.
